summary: Preserve the special RegExp(re) identity result when called as a function with a matching constructor and no flags.

target.notes: Function-call RegExp may return the argument itself; new RegExp(re) never uses this identity shortcut.

semantics.identity_if: IsRegExp(argument) && flags is undefined && argument.constructor === active RegExp

caveats: An own/inherited constructor override disables the identity shortcut.

tests.name: constructor override disables identity
tests.input: const r=/a/g; r.constructor=function X(){}; console.log(RegExp(r)===r, RegExp(r).source);
